about: What F-list's own parser says about each source below. Every case was run through the live parser on f-list.net, FList.TagParser.enableWarnings(); parseEverything(htmlentities(source)), and gave exactly these warnings, in this order. Add a case only after doing the same: a guessed verdict here makes both checks agree with the guess instead of with the site.
Read by renderer/src/lib/bbcode/validate.test.ts and sidecar/tests/test_bbcode_rules.py, so the preview's check and the MCP write guard are held to the same verdicts.
Each warning is a letter and a tag name. B: Bad BBCode in [x] tag. O: Open [x] tag is not properly closed. N: The [x] tag is not allowed here.

cases.note: A stray closer is shown as text, without a warning.
The well-formed [b] goes literal with its unclosed parent.
A crossed pair inside a wrapper.
Literal on the site, so never rendered, so never judged.
Structural warnings first, whatever the source order.
B, not O: a [/color follows later in the text.
Uppercase names are not tags to F-list: shown literally, without a warning.
